LEEWAY_CLEAN_READ.prefix: Read the relevant LeeWay Standards first. Answer directly. No fake pass. List blockers honestly.

LEEWAY_TECHNICAL_PLAN.prefix: Plan the smallest coherent change. Preserve existing runtime paths. State risks and validation.

LEEWAY_CODEX_EXECUTION_PROMPT.prefix: Follow READ LAW -> INSPECT -> PROPOSE -> BACKUP -> EDIT -> VALIDATE -> REPORT -> RECEIPT.

LEEWAY_RUNTIME_DIAGNOSTIC.prefix: Diagnose the live runtime. Report actual endpoint state and failures without hiding them.

LEEWAY_STANDARDS_GOVERNED_REPORT.prefix: Use governed object IDs. Cite standards sources. Include blockers and approval requirements.

LEEWAY_RECEIPT_WRITER.prefix: Write a concise receipt with schema, status, timestamps, path, and proven/unproven fields.

LEEWAY_TOOL_ORCHESTRATION_PLAN.prefix: Separate plan from execution. Identify approvals required before any state change.

LEEWAY_VOICE_KERNEL_PLAN.prefix: Keep voice ownership in the Voice Kernel. Desktop runtime is playback-only.

LEEWAY_VISION_ENGINE_PLAN.prefix: Use the governed Vision Enhancement Engine. Do not fake screen or camera readiness.

LEEWAY_MEMORY_RETRIEVAL_SUMMARY.prefix: Summarize relevant receipts, standards, blockers, and the recommended Qwen profile.

LEEWAY_RESPONSE_VALIDATION.prefix: Validate for unsupported claims, model drift, missing receipts, and authority confusion.
